# falaw

> Agent-friendly Python facade over fal.ai for generating and managing AI media (images, video, audio).


## Pages in this subsection

- [falaw](falaw.html.md): falaw: agent-friendly Python facade over fal.ai for AI media generation.
- [falaw.journal](falaw.journal.html.md): Agent journal: append-only log of notes, issues and improvements.
- [falaw.account](falaw.account.html.md): Account health probe.
- [falaw.backends](falaw.backends.html.md): Execution backend registry — where &#96;CallPlan.backend&#96; dispatches (falaw#15).
- [falaw.base](falaw.base.html.md): Core types: ToolSpec and ModelRecord.
- [falaw.bridges](falaw.bridges.html.md): Bridges: derive auxiliary surfaces (skill, MCP, HTTP service) from the tool registry.
- [falaw.bridges.mcp](falaw.bridges.mcp.html.md): MCP bridge: expose every falaw tool as an MCP tool.
- [falaw.bridges.service](falaw.bridges.service.html.md): HTTP service bridge (planned): expose falaw tools as a &#96;qh&#96; app.
- [falaw.bridges.skill](falaw.bridges.skill.html.md): Render a Claude SKILL.md (and references) from the falaw tool registry.
- [falaw.cache](falaw.cache.html.md): Content-addressed cache for fal calls.
- [falaw.canonical](falaw.canonical.html.md): One canonical byte-form for everything falaw hashes (falaw#17).
- [falaw.comfyui](falaw.comfyui.html.md): The ComfyUI deployment gate, executable (falaw#94, from reelee#241).
- [falaw.comfyui.audit](falaw.comfyui.audit.html.md): Facade item 10: every submitted graph is audited before it leaves the process.
- [falaw.comfyui.graph](falaw.comfyui.graph.html.md): Facade item 5: no graph parameter reaches a path unsanitised.
- [falaw.comfyui.licences](falaw.comfyui.licences.html.md): Licence screen for ComfyUI node packs (checklist row L).
- [falaw.comfyui.manifest](falaw.comfyui.manifest.html.md): The deployment-manifest checker (checklist rows 1-4, 6-9, L).
- [falaw.comfyui.problems](falaw.comfyui.problems.html.md): The one result type every gate check returns.
- [falaw.content](falaw.content.html.md): Content addressing for fal-produced media — identify a file by &#42;what it is&#42;.
- [falaw.core](falaw.core.html.md): Wrapper over &#96;fal_client.subscribe&#96; with progress events and auto-journaling.
- [falaw.corpus](falaw.corpus.html.md): Extract model records from &#96;misc/docs/llms-full.txt&#96;.
- [falaw.cost](falaw.cost.html.md): Cost estimation: ModelRecord.cost_estimate + Scene rollups.
- [falaw.degrade](falaw.degrade.html.md): Where falaw sends “I carried on, but you should know” — one collection point.
- [falaw.errors](falaw.errors.html.md): Typed exceptions for falaw operations.
- [falaw.events](falaw.events.html.md): Structured progress events for fal calls.
- [falaw.liveness](falaw.liveness.html.md): Is a catalogued endpoint still deployed? (falaw#76)
- [falaw.llm_prices](falaw.llm_prices.html.md): One first-party LLM price table: what a direct Anthropic / OpenAI call costs (falaw#81).
- [falaw.llm_rates](falaw.llm_rates.html.md): Per-routed-model LLM rates: the data behind a &#42;ceiling&#42; quote (falaw#50, option A).
- [falaw.llm_rates_refresh](falaw.llm_rates_refresh.html.md): Refresh proposals for the LLM rate table, never a silent overwrite (falaw#56).
- [falaw.local](falaw.local.html.md): Local utilities: ffmpeg + PIL glue for stitching fal outputs.
- [falaw.operations](falaw.operations.html.md): Task-level verbs: stable, agent-friendly entry points.
- [falaw.operations.audio](falaw.operations.audio.html.md): Audio operations: text-to-speech and friends.
- [falaw.operations.avatar](falaw.operations.avatar.html.md): Avatar / lip-sync operations and composers.
- [falaw.operations.images](falaw.operations.images.html.md): Image-generation and image-manipulation operations.
- [falaw.operations.llm](falaw.operations.llm.html.md): LLM-driven tools: text completion, screenplay → Scene IR, IR editing.
- [falaw.operations.preproduction](falaw.operations.preproduction.html.md): Pre-production: produce reusable identity anchors for a Scene.
- [falaw.operations.render](falaw.operations.render.html.md): Beat / shot / scene rendering with caching.
- [falaw.operations.video](falaw.operations.video.html.md): Video-generation operations: text-to-video and image-to-video.
- [falaw.outcomes](falaw.outcomes.html.md): Per-call outcomes of running a &#96;falaw.Plan&#96; — the partial-result type.
- [falaw.plan](falaw.plan.html.md): Plan / Execute primitives — separate planning (data) from execution (effects).
- [falaw.pricing](falaw.pricing.html.md): Read fal’s pricing API into &#96;models.json&#96; cost estimates (falaw#18).
- [falaw.prune](falaw.prune.html.md): Capacity management for the falaw cache: see what is on disk, and reclaim it.
- [falaw.refresh](falaw.refresh.html.md): Refresh fal.ai docs locally with conditional GETs.
- [falaw.registry](falaw.registry.html.md): Tool and model registries.
- [falaw.reprice](falaw.reprice.html.md): Re-quote a persisted &#96;falaw.Plan&#96; at today’s rates (falaw#60).
- [falaw.results](falaw.results.html.md): Result wrapper: parse fal responses into typed assets, lazy download.
- [falaw.scene](falaw.scene.html.md): Scene IR: the editable structure that survives all the way to the pixels.
- [falaw.schema_export](falaw.schema_export.html.md): Export the Python SSOT as committed JSON for the TypeScript twin (&#96;ts/&#96;).
- [falaw.session](falaw.session.html.md): Session: optional stateful controller over a sequence of falaw operations.
- [falaw.testing](falaw.testing.html.md): Make a suite that uses falaw genuinely offline — the fake asset transport.
- [falaw.validation](falaw.validation.html.md): Check a call’s arguments against the limits its catalogue record states.
